notes.levels: Gemini 4 Argon runs at low, medium and high; high is its highest level (AA, ARC Prize). AA rates only the high variant (slug gemini-4-argon, intelligenceIndexIsEstimated false).
notes.AA costs: costPerTask from intelligenceIndexEvaluations; AA Intelligence Index cost is intelligenceIndexCost.total. AA prices Argon at Google's 50% launch discount ($2/$10 per 1M tokens); at standard pricing the costs double.
notes.AA Index coding category: Mean of terminalBench40 and scicode, as for the other models.
notes.DeepSWE v1.1: 77.9% at high from Google's model card: Google's own run on a mini-swe-agent harness. The DeepSWE live leaderboard (last generated 2026-06-20) has no Argon.
notes.Terminal-Bench 2.1: AA has not run Argon (terminalBench21 null).
notes.Vals Index: Vals AI, updated 2026-10-18. All six models; Argon at high, every other model at max (Vals model pages).
notes.Vibe Code Bench v1.1: Vals AI, OpenHands harness, updated 2026-10-18. All six models; Argon at high, every other model at max.
notes.skipped: Model-card-only benchmarks (FrontierSWE v2, PostTrainBench, GraphWalks, LABBench 2, RiemannBench, Agent's Last Exam, Chartography, LVBench, CWE-bench, Vals Finance Agent v2, Harvey Legal Agent): no per-model effort level stated, or only Google's own runs on four models.
